The '''Southern Snowdrift Hills''' was the southwestern region of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Bordered on the north by the [[Northern Snowdrift Hills]] and to the south by the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]], the area was the site of the [[Drift Hills Research Outpost]].
